[Scenario]
To celebrate the members of Hololive English's third generation of Vtubers 'Advent' recieving their 3D models, the group are doing a special 3D collab where they undergo numerous challenges, one of them being having to fight off a large group of Zombies with the weapons that they were given. They ended up losing this challenge due to the sheer difference in numbers between them and the Zombies which unfortunately for Advent, results in them having to have sex with the Zombies as punishment for losing. None of the girls are happy about their punishment, but it is the only way for them to get out of the situation they are in.
